newsitem.title: USA: Nev. 300 MW coal-fired unit shut after explosion.
newsitem.headline: Nev. 300 MW coal-fired unit shut after explosion.

text.p: The 300 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Reid Gardner coal-fired power plant north of Las Vegas was shut early Sunday morning after an explosion in a boiler, a spokesman for Nevada Power Co said Monday.
Investigation of the explosion, which caused "significant damage," was expected to take two weeks, but some preliminary repairs will be carried out before the investigation is finished, he noted.
Nevada Power Co had no estimate for when the unit might return to service.
No one was injured in the blast.
The plant's 110 MW units one and two were operating normally, but the 110 MW unit 3 was off-line for scheduled maintenance, the spokesman said.
The Reid Gardner plant is owned by Nevada Power and the Califoria Department of Water Resources.
